classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design at most two compact protein binders against a user-supplied target PDB, evaluate structural quality and calibrated binding affinity via Boltz-2, add lightweight sequence QC, and return a ranked shortlist of up to two candidates.
assumptions: target_pdb must be an absolute local path to a valid PDB file supplied at runtime; the workflow cannot execute without it.
Two BindCraft trajectory shards (seeds 1 and 2, num_designs 1 each) run in parallel (max_parallel 2 per tool sharding metadata) to produce at most two candidates while keeping GPU cost minimal.
filter_mode is set to 'permissive' to maximise the probability that at least one design clears quality thresholds in a minimal 2-shard run; tighten to 'default' for stricter production runs.
target_chain defaults to 'A'; override via the workflow parameter if the binding interface is on a different chain.
binder_length defaults to 60 residues (within the BindCraft 30-150 range); adjust via the workflow parameter for a different scaffold length.

target_sequence is an optional workflow parameter used to populate the target chain entry in boltz2_affinity inline sequence mode; if omitted at runtime, the boltz2 nodes will include only the binder chain and affinity scores will be less reliable.
boltz2_affinity uses diffusion_samples=1 and diffusion_samples_affinity=3 for a fast but still calibrated affinity estimate.
sequence_analysis runs without the full per-residue table (include_residue_table=false) to keep output compact.

rank_designs aggregates BindCraft design metrics, Boltz-2 affinity predictions, and sequence QC into a final top-2 table; candidate submission is a post-workflow decision made after reviewing ranked outputs.
No hotspot constraints are applied; BindCraft will search the full target surface. Supply target_hotspot_residue_ids or target_hotspots in params to focus on a specific epitope.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: absolute path to the target structure PDB file must be provided by the user at runtime before workflow execution.
